#!/bin/bash

# Backup Script for Markdown Files
# This script copies all .md files from the workspace directory to a backup directory

# Define the source and backup directories
SOURCE_DIR="/tmp/mcp-workspace"
BACKUP_DIR="/tmp/mcp-workspace/backup"

# Create the backup directory if it doesn't exist
if [ ! -d "$BACKUP_DIR" ]; then
    echo "Creating backup directory: $BACKUP_DIR"
    mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
else
    echo "Backup directory already exists: $BACKUP_DIR"
fi

# Copy all .md files from source to backup directory
echo "Starting backup of .md files..."
echo "Source directory: $SOURCE_DIR"
echo "Backup directory: $BACKUP_DIR"
echo ""

# Count files before backup
md_count=$(find "$SOURCE_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md" -type f | wc -l)
echo "Found $md_count .md files to backup"
echo ""

# Copy all .md files
if find "$SOURCE_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md" -type f -exec cp {} "$BACKUP_DIR/" \; 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "✓ Successfully copied all .md files to backup directory"
    echo ""
    
    # List backed up files
    echo "Backed up files:"
    ls -lh "$BACKUP_DIR"/*.md 2>/dev/null | awk '{print "  - " $9 " (" $5 ")"}'
    echo ""
    echo "Backup completed successfully!"
else
    echo "✗ Error occurred during backup"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

./backup_md.sh
